category.name: Charts
category.preferred_workflow: Always bootstrap a local DOCX (or stream) when a task mentions an existing file, then locate a Shape with HasChart == true before accessing its Chart property; use DocumentBuilder.InsertChart with a supported ChartType, clear any default series, add series via the overload that accepts category labels and values, and finally save the document.

strict_api_bans: Never treat a generic Shape as a chart without first checking Shape.HasChart.
Do not reference ChartType, Chart, or any chart members that are not present in the installed Aspose.Words version.
Do not add or remove series without first clearing the default series collection.
canonical_patterns: Insert charts with DocumentBuilder.InsertChart specifying a valid ChartType enum value.
When a task references an existing file, folder, or stream, create a minimal sample DOCX in the example before proceeding.
Validate that each series has the same number of category labels before saving the document.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type fields or properties to satisfy the compiler.
Declare variables that may be null as nullable and guard their use with explicit null checks.
Prefer pattern matching (e.g., if (shape?.HasChart == true) ...) to avoid CS8602 warnings.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports CS0103 for 'ChartType' and CS0246 for missing 'Chart' namespace.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example uses a ChartType enum or Chart class that is not part of the referenced Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Import Aspose.Words.Drawing.Charts and use only the ChartType values documented for version 26.11.0; replace missing types with the correct enum members.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words API reference for the exact enum names before writing code and add the required using directive.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors appear for members such as CategoryAxis, DataLabel, Trendlines, Fill, or NumberFormat.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to access properties or methods that were removed or never existed in the current library.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove calls to unavailable members and use the supported alternatives, such as ChartSeries.HasDataLabels, ChartSeries.DataLabels, and ChartSeries.DataPoints[i].Format.Fill for coloring.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the official Aspose.Words chart documentation and verify member availability with IntelliSense or the API browser.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime or compile-time errors occur when accessing shape.Chart without checking HasChart.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example treats any Shape as a chart, violating the strict API ban.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Guard chart access with if (shape.HasChart) { Chart chart = shape.Chart; ... } and throw a clear exception when the condition fails.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include a HasChart check before dereferencing the Chart property.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors for missing Values, CategoryNames, or Add overloads; data misalignment warnings during rendering.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses outdated overload signatures or mismatched arrays for categories and values.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Clear the default series collection, then add series using the overload that accepts (string seriesName, string[] categories, double[] values) or (string seriesName, double[] xValues, double[] yValues) for scatter charts.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate that the length of category and value arrays match before calling Add, and always clear existing series first.

narrative.overview: The Charts category of Aspose.Words enables programmatic creation, manipulation, and export of Word chart objects. Verified examples demonstrate loading documents, inserting various chart types, customizing series, cloning shapes, and handling data labels using the native Aspose.Words chart API.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with concise guidance to generate correct, compilable C# snippets that work with Aspose.Words 26.11.0 chart features, ensuring proper document bootstrap, API usage, and null-safety.
validation_priorities: Ensure the code compiles against Aspose.Words 26.11.0 and that every accessed chart member exists in that version.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify that all chart members used in examples still exist in the latest Aspose.Words release and update the code accordingly.
